description: This file contains utility functions for filtering, sorting, and paginating recipes within a backend API. It provides methods for matching recipes against search queries, categories, ingredients, and for sorting recipe lists based on rating or title.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] paginate(items: List[Any], page: int, limit: int)
methods.description: Paginate a list and return a dict compatible with PaginatedResponse.

methods.name: str _norm(s: str)
methods.description: Normalize a string by stripping whitespace and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: bool recipe_matches_query(recipe: Dict, q: str)
methods.description: Check if recipe title or description matches a search query string.

methods.name: bool recipe_matches_category(recipe: Dict, category: str)
methods.description: Check if recipe's category matches the given category (case-insensitive).

methods.name: bool recipe_matches_ingredients_or(recipe: Dict, ingredients_csv: str)
methods.description: Determine if any ingredient in the recipe matches any of the tokens in the CSV string.

methods.name: bool recipe_matches_include_all(recipe: Dict, include_csv: str)
methods.description: Verify if the recipe includes all tokens specified in the include CSV string.

methods.name: List[Dict] sort_recipes(recipes: List[Dict], sort_by: str)
methods.description: Sorts a list of recipes based on specified criteria ('rating' or 'title').

ctags.name: paginate
ctags.pattern: /^def paginate(items: List[Any], page: int, limit: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
